detail.longDescription:
AskEasy* is your personal AI assistant, who helps with daily tasks, making your life easier, more fun, and efficient. 
It swiftly finds answers to any query, writes texts, generates images, assists with daily tasks, and can even recommend a book to read or a movie to watch! Simply input your request, and watch as accurate responses magically appear on your screen.
Key Features:
【AI IMAGE GENERATOR】
Transform words into stunning visuals. Enter a description, and let AI generate captivating images tailored to your vision.
【YOUR AI WRITING ASSISTANT】
From essays and ad copies to witty tweets and poems, smart AI writer generates polished content in seconds. If you're a student, professional, or content creator, this free AI writing tool ensures your texts are clear, creative, and engaging.
【UPLOAD AND ASK】
Save time searching! Upload PDFs to AskEasy*, and get precise answers and valuable insights fast and without manual searches.
【TITLE FOR PHOTO】
Effortlessly create creative captions, hashtags, and engaging stories for your photos. Perfect for social media posts!
Explore More AI Super Powers:
Language Assistance: Translate or simplify learning new languages.
Ask by Link: Paste a webpage or video URL to get the details you need without extra browsing.
Text Scanner: Snap a picture, and AI Chatbot analyzes text for quick insights.
Summary of Texts: Simplify complex articles or documents into easy-to-read pieces.
Quote Maker: Generate impactful and creative quotes in seconds.
Help with Daily Tasks: From grocery lists to travel plans, AskEasy* keeps life on track effortlessly.
Friendly ChatBot: More than just answers—it’s a witty, engaging companion to chat with anytime.

AskEasy is free to download. A subscription is required to use the service. 

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION: Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. The cost of the renewal depends on your subscription plan. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off in the user’s Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.
Privacy Policy: https://mychat-ai.cloud/pp
